papers.title: Fertility in Honduras
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of fertility in Honduras, using data from the period 1991-2022. Equations are estimated to identify the role of variables from the real, monetary, and labor sectors on fertility. The results show that fertility is mainly determined by female unemployment rates, salaried employment rates, and self-employment rates, with investment and exports also playing a role. A result of particular interest is the role of the economic dynamism of other Central American countries on Honduran fertility, which highlights the existence of a regional fertility “network”.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文利用1991至2022年的数据，研究了洪都拉斯生育率的决定因素。通过建立方程模型，分析了实体经济、货币市场和劳动力市场各变量对生育率的影响。研究结果表明，生育率主要受女性失业率、有薪就业率以及自雇率的影响，同时投资和出口也起到一定作用。特别值得关注的是，其他中美洲国家的经济活力对洪都拉斯生育率的影响，这表明该地区存在一种生育率的“联动机制”。。

papers.title: The Empathy Channel in Fertility -- by Sebastian Galiani, Raul A. Sosa
papers.abstract: Being around babies makes people want babies. We formalize this observation as the empathy channel: exposure to infants in the social environment activates neurobiological mechanisms that increase the desire for parenthood. As children become scarcer, this affective stimulus weakens, further eroding the motivation to have children. We embed the mechanism in a two-group overlapping-generations quantity-quality model. The empathy channel generates a positive externality, since each birth raises others’ desire for children, making the decentralized equilibrium inefficient. We characterize the optimal per-child subsidy and show that the first-order Pigouvian rate substantially overshoots the general-equilibrium optimum. The optimal targeting rule follows a Ramsey-like logic, directing the subsidy at the group with the most externality per fiscal dollar, not the group with the largest externality per child. The calibrated model suggests that the empathy channel can account for 3–33% of the fertility decline, with 13.4% at the baseline. At this baseline, the Pigouvian overshoot is 23–32% and the optimal subsidy raises welfare by 0.22% in consumption-equivalent terms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】与婴儿接触会让人产生想要拥有自己的孩子的愿望。我们将这一现象称为“共情机制”：在社会环境中接触婴儿会激活某些神经生物学机制，从而增强人们成为父母的意愿。然而，随着儿童数量的减少，这种情感刺激逐渐减弱，进一步削弱了人们生育的动机。我们将这一机制纳入一个包含两组人群、且世代重叠的定量-质量模型中进行分析。共情机制会产生正外部性，因为每个新生儿的诞生都会提升其他人对孩子的渴望，从而导致分散决策下的均衡状态变得低效。我们研究了最优的儿童补贴水平，并发现一阶庇古税（Pigouvian tax）的税率往往会大幅超过一般均衡下的最优水平。最优的补贴分配规则遵循类似拉姆齐（Ramsey）的逻辑，即将补贴定向给予每单位财政支出所产生的外部性最大的群体，而非每个孩子所带来外部性最大的群体。根据校准后的模型预测，共情机制可以解释生育率下降现象的3%至33%（基线情况下为13.4%）；在这一基线水平下，庇古税的过度调节效应为23%至32%，而最优补贴政策可使社会福利在消费等值意义上提高0.22%。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Profit Regulation and Strategic Transfer Pricing by Vertically Integrated Firms: Evidence from Health Care -- by Pragya Kakani, Eric Yde, Genevieve P. Kanter, Richard G. Frank, Amelia M. Bond
papers.abstract: We provide evidence of strategic transfer pricing by vertically integrated health care firms in response to insurer profit regulations. Insurers increased prices at vertically integrated pharmacies by 9.5% following the introduction of caps on insurer profits in Medicare Part D. We detect larger price increases by insurers that were at greatest risk of exceeding the allowable profit level. More than one-fifth of these higher prices were borne by the federal government. Our analysis illustrates that vertically integrated firms can evade profit regulation by “tunneling” profits to unregulated subsidiaries, undermining regulatory intent and increasing health care spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】我们提供了证据，表明垂直整合的医疗保健企业在面对保险公司利润监管时采取了战略性转移定价策略。在医疗保险D部分（Medicare Part D）实施利润上限规定后，保险公司将其在垂直整合药店中的药品价格提高了9.5%。我们发现，那些最有可能超出允许利润水平的保险公司提高了更高的价格。这些价格上涨带来的成本中，有超过五分之一由联邦政府承担。我们的分析表明，垂直整合的企业可以通过将利润“转移”至不受监管的子公司来规避利润监管，从而削弱监管效果，并增加医疗保健支出。。

papers.title: Evolution of Balanced Scorecard in the Context of Digital Transformation: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This research investigates the evolution of the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) in the context of digital transformation using a Systematic Literature Review (SLR). Although BSC has been widely applied, existing studies remain fragmented and lack an integrated explanation of how BSC adapts to digital complexity. This study analyzes 31 Scopus-indexed articles published between 2020 and 2025 using the PRISMA approach. The findings reveal three major shifts: (1) BSC has evolved from a static performance measurement tool into a dynamic, data-driven strategic management system supported by AI, big data analytics, and cloud computing; (2) BSC perspectives have developed through either the addition of new dimensions, such as IT environment and sustainability, or the redefinition of the four classical perspectives; and (3) key performance indicators have shifted toward digital-oriented measures, including digital maturity, data security, and sustainability performance. This study contributes by providing an integrated conceptual understanding of the Digital Balanced Scorecard (DBSC) and offers practical insights for organizations in designing adaptive, data-driven performance management systems in the digital era.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】本研究通过系统文献综述（Systematic Literature Review, SLR）探讨了平衡计分卡（Balanced Scorecard, BSC）在数字化转型背景下的演变过程。尽管BSC已被广泛应用，但现有研究仍较为零散，缺乏对其如何适应数字化复杂性的整体解释。本研究采用PRISMA方法分析了2020年至2025年间发表的31篇Scopus索引论文，发现BSC经历了三个主要变化：（1）BSC已从静态的绩效评估工具发展成为一种动态的、以数据为驱动的战略管理系统，该系统依托人工智能、大数据分析和云计算技术；（2）BSC的评估维度得到了扩展，要么通过新增维度（如信息技术环境和可持续性），要么通过对传统四个维度的重新定义来实现；（3）关键绩效指标逐渐转向与数字化相关的指标，包括数字化成熟度、数据安全性和可持续性绩效。本研究为数字化平衡计分卡（Digital Balanced Scorecard, DBSC）提供了系统的概念框架，并为组织在数字化时代设计适应性强的、以数据为导向的绩效管理系统提供了实践指导。。

papers.title: Digital Tax Governance in Optimizing Local Own-Source Revenue: Evidence from Kampar Regency, Indonesia
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: Fiscal decentralization has become a central policy in many developing countries aimed at improving local government autonomy and enhancing public service delivery. One key indicator of fiscal autonomy is the capacity of local governments to generate Local Own-Source Revenue (Pendapatan Asli Daerah/PAD). However, many local governments in Indonesia still depend heavily on fiscal transfers from the central government. This study examines the role of digital governance in optimizing local tax administration and increasing PAD in Kampar Regency, Riau Province. The research employs a qualitative descriptive approach supported by secondary fiscal data analysis. The findings indicate that digital tax administration contributes to improving transparency, administrative efficiency, and taxpayer compliance. Digital systems allow local governments to monitor tax transactions more effectively while reducing revenue leakage. However, challenges remain in terms of technological infrastructure, human resource capacity, and digital literacy among taxpayers. Strengthening digital governance in local taxation is therefore essential for improving fiscal sustainability and enhancing regional financial independence.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】财政分权已成为许多发展中国家的核心政策，旨在提高地方政府的自主权并改善公共服务的提供。衡量财政自主权的一个重要指标是地方政府生成地方自有收入（Pendapatan Asli Daerah/PAD）的能力。然而，印度尼西亚的许多地方政府仍然严重依赖中央政府的财政转移支付。本研究探讨了数字治理在优化廖内省坎帕尔县（Kampar Regency）的地方税收管理及增加PAD方面的作用。研究采用了定性描述方法，并辅以第二手财政数据分析。研究结果表明，数字税收管理有助于提高透明度、行政效率以及纳税人的遵从度。数字系统使地方政府能够更有效地监控税收交易，同时减少收入流失。不过，在技术基础设施、人力资源能力以及纳税人的数字素养方面仍存在挑战。因此，加强地方税收领域的数字治理对于提升财政可持续性和增强区域财政独立性至关重要。。

papers.title: The Effect of Coal Production, Domestic Market Obligation, Selling Price, Coal Reserves, and Mining Investment on Indonesia's Coal Export Realization
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: As the world's second-largest coal exporter, Indonesia faces complex dynamics in managing its coal export realizations amid domestic policy obligations and market fluctuations. This phenomenon is increasingly significant given coal's strategic role as a major source of state revenue and its position as a primary energy supplier to Asian emerging markets, particularly China and India. This study aims to analyze the determinants affecting Indonesia's coal export realizations. The research employs a quantitative approach using quarterly time-series data from 2014 to 2023, comprising 40 observations. The analytical methods utilized are the Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) to examine both short-term dynamics and long-term equilibrium relationships among variables. The independent variables examined include coal production volume, domestic market obligation (DMO), selling price, coal reserves, and mineral and coal sector investment, with coal export realization as the dependent variable. The findings reveal that simultaneously, all independent variables significantly influence coal export realizations. Partially, coal production, selling price, coal reserves, and investment demonstrate significant positive effects on export realizations. Conversely, domestic market obligation shows a significant negative effect on Indonesia's coal export realizations, indicating that mandatory domestic supply requirements constrain export volumes.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】作为世界第二大煤炭出口国，印度尼西亚在管理煤炭出口收入时面临着复杂的挑战，这些挑战源于国内政策要求与市场波动的双重影响。鉴于煤炭作为国家财政收入重要来源的战略地位，以及其作为亚洲新兴市场（尤其是中国和印度）主要能源供应者的角色，这一现象显得尤为突出。本研究旨在分析影响印度尼西亚煤炭出口收入的各种因素。研究采用了定量分析方法，使用了2014年至2023年的季度时间序列数据（共40个观测值），并运用向量误差修正模型（VECM）来探讨变量之间的短期动态关系和长期均衡关系。研究涉及的自变量包括煤炭产量、国内市场义务（DMO）、售价、煤炭储量以及矿产和煤炭行业投资，因变量为煤炭出口收入。研究结果表明，所有自变量均对煤炭出口收入具有显著影响：其中煤炭产量、售价、煤炭储量和投资对出口收入具有正向促进作用；而国内市场义务则对出口收入产生显著负面影响，表明强制性的国内供应要求限制了出口规模。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Predicted Incrementality by Experimentation (PIE) for Ad Measurement -- by Brett R. Gordon, Robert Moakler, Florian Zettelmeyer
papers.abstract: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) provide the most credible estimates of advertising incrementality but are difficult to scale. We propose Predicted Incrementality by Experimentation (PIE), which reframes ad measurement as a campaign-level prediction problem. PIE uses a sample of RCTs to learn a mapping from campaign features to causal effects, then applies it to campaigns not run as RCTs. Because the RCTs identify the causal effects, PIE can incorporate post-determined features—campaign-level aggregates such as test-group outcomes, exposure rates, and last-click conversions, computed after campaign completion. These metrics reflect the consumer behaviors that generate treatment effects, so they carry predictive information about incrementality even though they would be invalid controls in a causal model. Using 2,226 Meta ad experiments, PIE achieves an out-of-sample R2 = 0.88 for incremental conversions per dollar, compared to R2 = 0.19 for industry-standard 7-day last-click attribution. In a decision-making framework, PIE disagrees with RCT-based decisions in only 8–12% of campaigns, compared to 12–20% for last-click attribution. We conclude that PIE can help scale causal measurement from a limited number of RCTs to a large set of non-experimental campaigns.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随机对照试验（RCTs）为广告效果的增量性提供了最可靠的评估，但其应用范围较为有限。我们提出了“通过实验预测增量性”（Predicted Incrementality by Experimentation, PIE）方法，该方法将广告效果测量问题重新定义为一种基于整个广告活动的预测问题。PIE利用一部分RCT数据来建立活动特征与实际效果之间的映射关系，随后将该映射关系应用于那些未采用RCT方法进行测试的活动。由于RCTs本身能够直接识别出广告效果的因果关系，因此PIE可以纳入一些事后确定的指标——例如活动结束后的测试组结果、用户曝光率以及点击转化率等。这些指标虽然在实际的因果模型中无法作为有效的对照组，但它们能够反映产生广告效果的消费者行为，从而具备关于广告效果增量的预测价值。通过对2,226个Meta广告实验的数据进行分析，PIE在预测每美元投入所带来的转化增量方面的模型拟合度（R²值）达到了0.88，而行业标准的7天点击归因方法的拟合度仅为0.19。在决策框架中，PIE在8%至12%的情况下会与基于RCT的决策结果产生分歧，而基于点击归因的方法这一比例高达12%至20%。综上...。研究方法：实验方法、随机实验。

papers.title: Bad News and Policy Views: Expectations, Disappointment, and Opposition to Affirmative Action -- by Louis-Pierre Lepage, Heather Sarsons, Michael Thaler
papers.abstract: There is widespread opposition to affirmative action policies. We study whether personal disappointments shape preferences for such policies. Specifically, we test whether individuals' college admissions outcomes, relative to their expectations, influence their attitudes toward affirmative action policies. Using a retrospective survey among recent White and Asian college applicants, we find that disappointed individuals—those who were admitted to fewer schools than anticipated—are relatively more likely to believe that affirmative action played an important role in their admissions outcomes, have the lowest support for affirmative action policies, and are more willing to donate to an anti-affirmative action organization. They also hold more negative views about the academic qualifications of under-represented minorities. To isolate the causal effect of "bad news" from selection, we conduct a complementary survey experiment with parents of future college applicants. We randomize whether parents receive information about their child's admissions prospects. Providing bad news to overconfident parents causes them to increase opposition to affirmative action and donate to an anti-affirmative action organization. Results suggest that some individuals attribute bad news to external factors, specifically policies that benefit out-groups.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】普遍存在对平权行动政策的反对意见。我们研究了个人遭遇的挫折是否会影响人们对这些政策的偏好。具体而言，我们考察了个人的大学录取结果（相对于其预期而言）是否会影响他们对平权行动政策的态度。通过对近期申请大学的白人和亚裔学生进行的回顾性调查，我们发现那些感到失望的人（即被录取的学校数量低于预期的人）更倾向于认为平权行动在他们的录取结果中起到了重要作用，他们对平权行动政策的支持度最低，并且更愿意向反对平权行动的组织捐款。此外，他们对代表性不足的少数群体的学术能力持有更为负面的看法。为了将“坏消息”的影响与个体选择因素区分开来，我们还对未来大学申请者的家长进行了补充性调查实验。我们随机决定家长是否会收到关于孩子录取情况的信息。向过于自信的家长传递坏消息会让他们更加反对平权行动，并更有可能向反对平权行动的组织捐款。研究结果表明，部分人会将负面结果归因于外部因素，尤其是那些对弱势群体有利的相关政策。。研究方法：调查数据、实验方法。

papers.title: Forecasting the Economic Effects of AI -- by Ezra Karger, Otto Kuusela, Jason Abaluck, Kevin A. Bryan, Basil Halperin, Todd R. Jones, Connacher Murphy, Philip Trammell, Matt Reynolds, Dan Mayland, Ria Viswanathan, Ananaya Mittal, Rebecca Ceppas de Castro, Josh Rosenberg, Philip Tetlock
papers.abstract: We elicit forecasts of how AI will affect the U.S. economy, comparing the beliefs of five groups: academic economists, employees at AI companies, policy researchers focused on AI, highly accurate forecasters, and the general public. The median respondent in each group expects substantial advances in AI capabilities by 2030, small declines in labor force participation consistent with demographic shifts, and an annual GDP growth rate of 2.5%, which exceeds both the typical medium-run (2.0%) and long-run (1.7%) baseline forecasts from government agencies and private-sector forecasters. Conditional on a “rapid” AI progress scenario, in which AI systems surpass human performance on many cognitive and physical tasks, experts forecast substantial, though not historically unprecedented, economic shifts: annualized GDP growth rising to around 4% and the labor force participation rate falling from its current level of 62% to 55% by 2050, with roughly half of that decline—equivalent to around 10 million lost jobs—attributable to AI. A variance decomposition suggests that expert disagreement about these effects is driven primarily by different beliefs about the economic effects of highly capable AI systems rather than by disagreement about the pace of AI progress. These forecasts map onto notably different policy preferences across groups: experts strongly favor targeted measures such as worker retraining, whereas the general public supports both targeted programs and broader interventions, including a job guarantee and universal basic income.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们收集了关于人工智能（AI）将如何影响美国经济的预测意见，比较了五组人群的观点：学术经济学家、AI企业的员工、专注于AI的政策研究人员、高精度预测专家以及普通公众。每组受访者中的中位数预测认为，到2030年AI能力将取得显著提升，劳动力参与率会因人口结构变化而略有下降，年均GDP增长率将达到2.5%，这一预测高于政府机构和私营部门预测机构通常给出的中期（2.0%）和长期（1.7%）基准值。在假设AI技术“迅速”发展的情景下，即AI系统在许多认知和体力任务上超越人类表现的情况下，专家们预测经济将发生重大变化（尽管这些变化并非史无前例）：年均GDP增长率将升至约4%，劳动力参与率将从目前的62%降至55%，其中约一半的降幅（相当于约1000万个就业岗位的流失）可归因于AI技术的发展。方差分解分析表明，专家们在这些预测上的分歧主要源于他们对高能力AI系统经济影响的看法不同，而非对AI发展速度的争议。这些预测结果反映了不同群体在政策偏好上的显著差异：专家们强烈支持有针对性的措施（如员工再培训），而普通公众则同时支持有针对性的项目和更广泛的干预措施，包括就业保障和普遍基本收入制度。。
